title: A flatness criterion for pseudo-effective sheaves on compact Kähler spaces
summary: In this paper, we prove that if $E$ is a pseudo-effective sheaf with vanishing first Chern class on a klt compact Kähler space $X$, then, after passing to a finite quasi-étale cover, the reflexive pullback of $E$ is locally free and flat. This extends the flatness criterion of Höring--Peternell, originally established for projective varieties, to the Kähler setting. The proof relies on two main ingredients, both of which are new even in the projective case.
